title: Write a checksum manifest and verify an old one
notes: skill: shasum/find/sort pipelines: a sha256 manifest of a tree in shasum format with exclusions and byte-order sorting, plus a verify report of a stale SHA256SUMS (OK/FAILED/MISSING); traps: paths relative to release/, locale vs byte order with mixed case, spaces in names, .sig/output exclusions, '*' binary-mode entries and comments (knob 3), dotfiles, tmp/ and CRLF (knob 4), non-ASCII names, upper-case hex and ./ prefixes (knob 5); pass_guess_permille: 450
